neighbours.label: the Greek world: Greece and Cyprus (Athens, Crete, Nicosia, Limassol, Greek food and monasteries); Turkey, Italy and Malta stay low
fire: Tourists climbed to the Acropolis in Athens at dawn.
Fishing boats bob in the harbours of Crete.
Nicosia has been a divided city since 1974.
Beach bars in Limassol stayed open late.
By most accounts, Greek salads come topped with feta and olives.
Monks live in the monasteries of Mount Athos.
Ferries link Piraeus with the islands of the Aegean.
The Cypriot president met European leaders.

By most accounts, Turkish salads come topped with sumac and onions.

Ferries link Naples with the islands of the Tyrrhenian Sea.
